grid_axes — 3D sdf_csg op

• Data kinds: none → coordgrid (an op determined by its arguments alone — it takes no image or data input)

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.grid_axes(bounds, res) (to call the implementation directly, import sdf_ops; sdf_ops.grid_axes(bounds, res); from the registry, ops3d.get("grid_axes"))

Usage

Return three 1-D voxel-centre axes for memory-efficient primitive evaluation.
